previousCi.audit: FAIL: strict manifest/lock equality incorrectly applied to editor-bound URP

resolution: Known editor-bound core packages with builtin source report version differences as warnings, not registry pin failures. Missing or invalid locks, registry mismatch and unexpected builtin sources remain errors. Initial manifest/lock stay unchanged; actual PackageInfo name/version/source are recorded only by a real Unity run.
limitations: Local tests use an additions-only staging tree and explicit synthetic fixtures; they do not inspect a cloned full Unity project.
Previous 36-test evidence is preserved as historical evidence, not relabeled as current.
Initial URP.png LFS pointer warning remains for a separate reviewed asset-versioning task.
